name: Galerie de l'UQAM
funding: University gallery. Named partners: Canada Council for the Arts, CALQ and UQAM; donations go through the UQAM foundation.

name: MAC Montréal
funding: Quebec crown corporation (C$12.5M Quebec grants, 2024-25). Donors: Banque Nationale (lead), Bronfman foundation, Power Corporation, AtkinsRéalis, BMO, RBC, Scotiabank, Desjardins.

name: PHI Foundation
funding: Greenberg family (Minto real estate fortune). Federal and Quebec governments committed C$26.6M in 2022 for the PHI contemporain expansion. Programming is free.

name: The Polygon Gallery
funding: Opened 2017 on C$20M campaign; 2024 supporters: Canada Council, BC Arts Council, North Vancouver, BMO ($150k+), TD, RBC, Rogers, Polygon Homes, Audain endowment.

name: Oakville Galleries
funding: Canada Council, Ontario Arts Council, Government of Ontario, Town of Oakville, Mondriaan Fund. Sponsors: Hatch, Taglieri Group, Siemens, Chatsworth Fine Homes.

name: Musée national des beaux-arts du Québec
funding: C$34.1M revenue 2023-24 (C$24.5M Quebec grants). Sponsors Hydro-Québec, Simons, Air Canada, Banque Nationale, BMO, Desjardins, RBC Foundation.

name: MacKenzie Art Gallery
funding: Canada Council, Saskatchewan Arts Board, City of Regina, Sask Lotteries. 2024-25 corporate sponsors: TD Ready Commitment ($200k+), Rawlco Radio, RBC Foundation, Canada Life, SaskTel.

name: Owens Art Gallery
funding: 2023-24 public grants c. CAD 240k (Canada Council $180k, NB Tourism, Heritage & Culture $59k, Town of Sackville $1k) plus Mount Allison University; small private internship donors.

name: Remai Modern
funding: C$13.1M revenue in 2025, 51% from City of Saskatoon grants. Sponsors include the Frank and Ellen Remai Foundation, SaskEnergy, SIGA, SaskTel, SGI and TD.

name: Art Metropole
funding: Canada Council for the Arts, Ontario Arts Council, City of Toronto through the Toronto Arts Council, plus donors, members and volunteers.

name: Mercer Union
funding: Canada Council, Ontario Arts Council, Toronto Arts Council. TD Bank Group leads support for a communications post; Burdock Brewery is beverage sponsor.
